mapper.select: select id from cms_registration where id = #{id} for update
select member_id from club where id = #{id} and status = 1 and del_flag = 0 for update
select * from cms_registration_seat where registration_id = #{registrationId} order by seat_no for update
mapper.insert: insert into cms_registration_seat (registration_id, seat_no, status) values (#{registrationId}, #{seatNo}, 0)
mapper.select: select id, topic_id as topicId, activity_id as activityId, registration_id as registrationId, verifier_member_id as verifierMemberId, verify_time as verifyTime from coop_group_member_verify where registration_id = #{registrationId} for update

select r.id from cms_registration r left join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and a.id = r.owner_id left join coop_group_member_verify gm on gm.registration_id = r.id left join cms_registration_seat s on s.registration_id = r.id and s.topic_id = #{topicId} and s.activity_id = #{activityId} and s.status = 1 where r.order_num > 1 and s.id is null and ((r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{topicId} and gm.topic_id = #{topicId} and gm.activity_id = #{activityId} and gm.verify_time < #{cutoff}) or (r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and a.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.verification_status = 1 and r.verification_time < #{cutoff})) order by r.id for update

select s.* from cms_registration_seat s join cms_registration r on r.id = s.registration_id left join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and a.id = r.owner_id left join coop_group_member_verify gm on gm.registration_id = s.registration_id and gm.topic_id = s.topic_id and gm.activity_id = s.activity_id where s.topic_id = #{topicId} and s.activity_id = #{activityId} and s.status = 1 and s.verified_at < #{cutoff} and ((r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = s.topic_id and gm.id is not null) or (r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = s.activity_id and a.topic_id = s.topic_id)) order by s.registration_id, s.seat_no for update
